sentences.text: My name is Ranger Connie and I am reporting live from Grand Canyon National Park.
And I am an education ranger here.
I pretty much give programs and lessons to students like yourself from K through 12.
And that's one of my favorite things to do is actually to teach the public about these really beautiful places.
And the second part is I get to travel to different parks, like here I'm in the Grand Canyon National Park and now I'm here in Yosemite.
So here I'm also an education ranger.
And I was actually a teacher before this.
I taught in Los Angeles for seven years.
So it's been really awesome just teaching here, leading field trips, doing virtual programs.
And yeah, just changing my classroom from an actual classroom, really small and enclosed to somewhere as beautiful as this.
